text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My first three years with T.M. Opera O were dramatic, to say the least, but they have now come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a decent record coupled with a lasting impact. But the Centurial Overlord is not about to go quiet.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas! How many times must our views clash?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah! But now it makes sense. Now that I have become the Centurial Overlord…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My life will become eternal. It's this grand design which they couldn't hope to comprehend.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! Lend me your ears, Trainer! In honor of my achievements…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A special race is to be held in my name.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: They are calling it the T.M. Opera O Commemoration Race!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Isn't the name absolutely ingenious? With me as its theme, can't you hear the underlying melody?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The name sounds a little on the nose if you ask me, but it's a real honor either way.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: However! The URA and I cannot come to an agreement as to what the race should entail.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Unlike you, they do not comprehend the essence of my greatness. It's been made evident by their proposals.
choice_data_list: What kind of ideas do they have?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ones that are plain, ordinary, and dull.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I give a one-hour performance leading up to the race and the victor receives a life-size trophy of myself obligatorily via mail.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That is all they were willing to concede. How could such an underdeveloped event be called a commemoration for me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like they gave a lot of ground to her… But it apparently isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am the Centurial Overlord. It only makes sense that they bend to my every whim.
choice_data_list: Well, what kind of race do you want?
Well, what kind of race do you want?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, a wonderful question…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It would take place at the newly constructed T.M. Opera O Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Organized by me, hosted by me, attended by me, and run by… me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am the victor! I am the loser! And I am the presenter!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A flawless race colored in my brilliant hue from start to finish!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now that is an event worthy of the name T.M. Opera O Commemorative Race! Haaah ha ha!
choice_data_list: What you described isn't really a race though.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mngh! Hm, now that you mention it, that may be a fair point…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But we ought not to fuss over the specifics. This will do so long as I am beautiful, with the Centurial Overlord's authority thoroughly apparent.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I will make one more attempt to negotiate. Accompany me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Show me what the Centurial Trainer can do at the table.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm dragged away, like a cat taken by its scruff. She's as reckless and demanding as ever.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Lofty laughter echoes across the negotiating table.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O not only stirs the pot—her antics keep everyone well entertained.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's right. This is her stage, where the laughter and surprises never end.
